Compassion unites, jo division alag karta.
Apna mind bolo, chahe voice shake kare.
Empathy: dusre ki nazar se dekhna.
Empathy heart ki intelligence hai.
Badhne aur asli roop banne ke liye himmat chahiye.
Sabse bhayanak garibi tanhai hai, aur be-pyar mehsoos karna.
Karuna roz ka decision hai jo tum chunte ho.
Trust construction mein pyaar hai.
Sabse best pyaar jo badhta hai.
Rishtay honesty se bante hain.
Pyaar woh halat hai jahan dusre ki khushi tumhari apni khushi ke liye zaroori ho jati hai.
Jo tum khud nahi chahte, woh doosron par mat karo.
Pyaar empathy ka child hai.
Pyaar ek constant work in progress hai.
True love ka raasta smooth kabhi nahi hota.
Compassion—love ka radical roop hai.
Sab just better love karne ki koshish me.
Love me accountability seekhte.
Past se peace banao; wo tumhara hissa rahega.
Parwah karna—pyaar ka tareeqa hai.
Rishte ki sehat self-awareness se shuru hoti hai.
Togetherness me thodi space rehne do.
Pyaar hi pul hai tum aur sab ke beech.
Love wise hai, love brave hai.
Acche se love = dekhna seekhna.
Pyaar mein hamesha thodi paagalpan hoti hai.
Pyaar verb hai; karo.

Hum apne aap ko accept karte jab hum different banne ki demand chhor dete.

Asli pyaar andha nahi; zyada dekhta, kam nahi.
